LanguageData.PDX_SettingsIntro: This source-included example demonstrates only documented public APIs. Reward delivery, Pawn state, deals, and events remain owned by Prisoner Diplomacy.
LanguageData.PDX_ShowHeaderWidget: Show the example API header strip
LanguageData.PDX_ShowHeaderWidgetDesc: Adds one compact, read-only strip to the Prisoner Diplomacy faction header.
LanguageData.PDX_EnablePersonasDesc: Provides bounded narrative defaults for Empire, pirate, and tribal factions. This cannot change gameplay.
LanguageData.PDX_VerboseLoggingDesc: Reserved for authors extending this sample. Normal users can leave it disabled.
LanguageData.PDX_ReportCopied: The public API report was copied and written to the game log.
LanguageData.PDX_HeaderStatusTooltip: This strip is drawn by IPrisonerDiplomacyUiExtension using read-only snapshot and adapter data.
LanguageData.PDX_NoPrisonerSnapshot: The selected Pawn has no public Prisoner Diplomacy snapshot.
LanguageData.PDX_NoNegotiator: No available colonist can be used for the preview.
LanguageData.PDX_PreviewLogged: The read-only demand preview was written to the game log.
LanguageData.PDX_RewardSealDescription: Two low-technology treaty tokens. The core validates their ThingDef, value, quantity, persistence, and exactly-once delivery.
LanguageData.PDX_RewardLedgerDescription: A high-technology trade ledger. The core prices and delivers it only after a verified prisoner handoff.
LanguageData.PDX_EventNeutralDescription: Catalog metadata selecting the core neutral trade family. API 1.2 does not let this add-on schedule it.
LanguageData.PDX_EventInfiltrationDescription: Catalog metadata selecting the core false-surrender family. The core remains the event authority.
LanguageData.PDX_EventTrialDescription: Catalog metadata selecting the core public-trial family. The add-on cannot apply its outcome.
LanguageData.PDX_EventAmbushDescription: Catalog metadata selecting the core ransom-ambush family. The core validates source deals and retaliation.
